column3: With respect to the Holiday Inn St. Petersburg West Mortgage Loan (2.2%), a release at a northerly adjacent gas station is being actively remediated by the responsible party in the form of Pump and Treat, Air Sparging and Soil Vapor Extraction; the adjacent leaking underground storage tank is active. A consultant retained to complete site response actions at such adjacent property is addressing impacts and the Mortgaged Property is cooperating by allowing access to monitoring wells. The consultant has proposed two additional intermediate wells be installed in the northeastern and north-central portions of the Mortgaged Property. Based on review of the groundwater data available for the Mortgaged Property, the presence of groundwater contamination migrated from the northeast adjoining property with this open case is considered an off-site REC and a business environmental risk to the Mortgaged Property. Based on the identification of a responsible party and ongoing remedial activities under regulatory oversight, the ESA concluded that no further assessment is warranted. The ESA recommended continued cooperation by providing access to the Mortgaged Property for the case until a regulatory closure is achieved.
